Harper Lightspark[1] is a dead gold dwarven Harper whose corpse is in the Shadow-Cursed Lands at X: 92 Y: 107, close to  He Who Was. He, and two other Harpers,[2] went on an expedition to scout the boundaries of the Shadow Curse, before eventually getting lost and succumbing to it before they could make it back to the Last Light Inn.

History

Scouting Expedition

Lightspark, along with two other Harpers, went on to scout the hills east of the Last Light Inn in an attempt to find the borders of the Shadow Curse, discovering an abandoned house just east of the inn at (X: 33 Y: 145) and an eery ruined home on a nearby hillock.

One of the Harpers he was with mentioned hearing a  child's laughter from the ruined home, and observing Githyanki warriors approaching the house, to which Lightspark noted incredulously in his journal that he hoped his fellow scout was imagining things.[3]

However, Lightspark and his scouting party eventually fall prey to the Shadow Curse before bringing the  Harper Journal back to the Inn.

      Last Light Inn... sanctuary from shadows... stronghold...

    • Harper Lightspark
      Scouting... seeking... gaps in cultist defences...
      • Did you find a gap in the cultist defences?
        • Harper Lightspark
          Caravan... to Moonrise Towers... know how to keep the shadows at bay...

    • Harper Lightspark
      Last Light... Isobel...
